overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Research-backed VR biology and physics modules for K-12. Immersive storytelling improved student comprehension by 35%, across the full design lifecycle.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: K-12 STEM is abstract on flat screens; students struggle to connect concepts to experience.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Designed biology/physics modules end-to-end — research, narrative, interaction and deployment — using immersive storytelling at true scale.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: 35% lift in student comprehension — research-backed VR that turns lessons into explorable worlds.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for Inspirit VR — Research-backed VR biology and physics modules for K-12. Immersive storytelling improved student comprehension by 35%, across the full design lifecycle.
